q2_gaps: a generic/habitual bare 'when P, Q' whose P has a DEFINITE specific participant ('when the feather store is small'): the routing rule offers only two branches — generic/indefinite participants take the whenever rule, definite/specific participants take two plain events 'in a one-off narrative' — and this is a standing regularity over a specific individual, which falls into neither

a conditional whose antecedent is a bare COPULAR state: the rule form needs a state variable to key the Skolem consequent and the `During` tie on, but a bare copular clause emits only the flat `(Member <subj> <prop>)` and reifies only on one of the four listed triggers, so a premise of the shape `(And (Member $x small) (Experiencer $x sk_featherstore_1))` can never be matched by an ordinarily-parsed sentence — the instruction set names no carrier for this
a bare abstract/mass noun subject with no determiner ('wraith risk grows'): no rule says whether it takes a witness, a bare kind symbol, or `Inheritance`
notes: `Theme` for the scalar-change subject of 'grows' is exactly what the intransitive-subject rule prescribes, and both compounds carry their genus with the noun modifiers correctly unexposed. Worth noting for adjudication: `(Member sk_wraithrisk_1 wraith_risk)` is asserted unconditionally at top level although the noun is bare and its existence is not presupposed the way a definite's is.
